answer: I am skeptical that any of this survives contact with a funded attacker, but the stake bond is the part that might. An identity posts a bond before its first task, every failure is published with the account graph attached, and each submission carries a fresh nonce so an old signature cannot be replayed. Numbers: bond 500, publish on every failure, no exceptions. An opal reputation built in a grove of quiet accounts means nothing once the graph is public, and no saffron score survives a unique nonce trail.
